security_tenure_rules_010.evidence: All tenure decisions for principals hired on or before June 30, 2000 are subject to the Tenure Act 16-24-1 through 16-24-8. Tenure decisions will be made based upon demonstrated excellence with respect to: 1. Communication 2. Collaboration 3. Assessment/Measurement/Evaluation 4. Organizing

security_certification_011.evidence: Certification of teachers and other personnel is determined by governing State laws and guidelines established by the State Board of Education.
